sentences.text: Nevadadromeus was a small, extinct ornithischian dinosaur belonging to the thescelosaurine group.
Its remains were found in the Willow Tank Formation in Nevada, United States.
The holotype specimen, labeled NSC 2008-002, was discovered near the Valley of Fire in 2008.
The species was formally described and published in October 2022.
The specific name 'schmitti' honors the geologist James G. Schmitt.
Although the fossils show features of both thescelosaurines and orodromines, researchers consider it more likely to be a thescelosaurine.
Nevadadromeus is the oldest known member of the thescelosaurine subfamily in North America.
Nevadadromeus lived during the mid-Cretaceous period, approximately 100 to 95 million years ago, in the Cenomanian stage.
The time range for Nevadadromeus is estimated to be between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago.
